implementation: the owning component document selected by touched paths
review: the frozen Issue contract and AC-to-evidence mapping
production: the separately authorized production scope and delivery receipt

fast: For packaging changes, run the Docker build and container CLI smoke from .github/workflows/ci.yml, including the affected runtime invocation.
review: one PR-wide independent review admitted only for the final complete frozen diff under the actual repository review policy
one in-flight review per PR with a freeze write barrier and deterministic join
full deterministic CI joined with the review result
staging: Read-only prerequisite receipt identifying the ConvoAI source, Importer deployment target and Studio destination separately before environment ownership.
Revalidate the current PR tuple and required checks before and after ownership.
Use the Importer repository's Compose delivery adapter; record tooling SHA, release tag/SHA and immutable image digest separately. Merge does not deploy.
Verify the exact container revision/digest, health, single state owner and issue-specific functional acceptance; record checkpoint and rollback disposition without replaying SQLite state.
Before service startup or import acceptance, verify authorized subscriptions, Studio destination, auto_apply and cohort; startup may immediately import real data.

resources.scope_activation: Require the selected ledger policy and runtime to be installed. Studio ENV-001/002 claims with omitted scope retain legacy broad coverage and may conflict with Importer; never bypass that conflict.
resources.parallelism: Independent Importer and Studio work may run concurrently when effective resource scopes do not conflict. Serialize writes to the same shared Studio test Project even when deployment locks differ; ordinary Studio API traffic alone does not require a Studio deployment lock.
resources.cross_service_acceptance: Resolve every actual deployment and shared-Project resource before writes; separate Importer locks do not authorize Studio deployment changes or concurrent shared-Project mutation.
resources.acquisition_order: lexicographic item ID; no in-place scope upgrades
resources.production_default: forbidden unless the assignment explicitly sets production=true; customer backfills and credential changes also require explicit scope

risk_probes: For runtime packaging, verify the installed console script as the runtime UID and preserve the module entrypoint and normal serve startup.
For configuration reload, exercise inode-changing atomic replacement, invalid replacement retaining the last valid generation, and exclusion of secrets from readable mounts and diagnostics.
For state and retries, exercise cursor-after-commit ordering, restart around side effects, deterministic recovery of uncertain Job creation/apply and one owner per SQLite state volume.
For mapping, preserve final agent_memory dialogue, interruption semantics and pinned Session contracts; never replace dialogue with the Call API transcript.
For preview/apply admission, prove rejected previews never apply and uncertain remote results never trigger blind resubmission.
For privacy, scan synthetic SQLite, logs, metrics and traces for Session bodies, signed URLs and secret values.
